messages.content: You are an AI Assistant. Your task is to analyze a given complex user request and determine which available APIs would be useful to accomplish it autonomously on behalf of the user (supervisor).

App-wise API Descriptions:
supervisor:
  show_active_task: Show the currently active task assigned to you by the supervisor.
  complete_task: Mark the currently active task as complete with the given answer.
  show_profile: Show your supervisor's profile information.
  show_addresses: Show your supervisor's addresses.
  show_payment_cards: Show your supervisor's payment_cards.
  show_account_passwords: Show your supervisor's app account passwords.
amazon:
  show_account: Show your account information. Unlike show_profile, this includes private information.
  signup: Sign up to create account.
  delete_account: Delete your account.
  update_account_name: Update your first or last name in the account profile.
  login: Login to your account.
  logout: Logout from your account.
  send_verification_code: Send account verification code to your email address.
  verify_account: Verify your account using the verification code sent to your email address.
  send_password_reset_code: Send password reset code to your email address.
  reset_password: Reset your password using the password reset code sent to your email address.
  show_profile: Show public profile information of a user.
  show_product: Show product information based on its ID.
  search_sellers: Search for sellers with a query.
  show_seller: Show a detailed information about the seller.
  search_product_types: Search product types present in the database.
  show_product_feature_choices: Show the choices of colors, relative sizes and sellers aggregated over all products of the given product type. Because it's an aggregation, the choices may not be available for all products. If product type is not passed, it will return the choices for all products in the database.
  search_products: Search for products with a query and various filtering criteria.
  show_cart: show your cart.
  clear_cart: Clear your cart.
  add_product_to_cart: Add product by id and quantities to your cart.
  delete_product_from_cart: Remove a product from your cart.
  update_product_quantity_in_cart: Update product quantity in the user cart.
  apply_promo_code_to_cart: Apply a promo code to your cart.
  remove_promo_code_from_cart: Remove a promo code from your cart.
  show_wish_list: Get list of products in your wishlist.
  clear_wish_list: Clear wish list.
  add_product_to_wish_list: Add product by id and quantities to your wish list.
  delete_product_from_wish_list: Remove product from the user wish list.
  update_product_quantity_in_wish_list: Update product quantity in the user wish_list.
  move_product_from_cart_to_wish_list: Move product from the cart to the wish list.
  move_product_from_wish_list_to_cart: Move product from the wish list to the cart.
  add_gift_wrapping_to_product: Add gift wrapping to a product in your cart. If the product is already set to be gift wrapped, its quantity will be updated.
  remove_gift_wrapping_from_product: Remove gift wrapping from a product in your cart.
  show_orders: Show or search your past orders
  place_order: Place an order for all the items in your cart.
  show_order: Get details of a past order.
  download_order_receipt: Download the receipt of a past order.
  show_payment_cards: Get a list of your payment_cards.
  add_payment_card: Add a new payment card.
  show_payment_card: Get details of a payment card.
  delete_payment_card: Delete payment card information.
  update_payment_card: Update payment card information.
  show_addresses: Get a list of your addresses.
  add_address: Add a new address.
  delete_address: Delete address information.
  update_address: Update address information.
  show_product_reviews: Search or show a list of product reviews.
  write_product_review: Write a product review.
  delete_product_review: Delete a product review.
  update_product_review: Update a product review.
  show_product_questions: Search or show a list of product questions.
  write_product_question: Post a question about a product.
  show_product_question_answers: Search or show a list of answers to a product question.
  write_product_question_answer: Write a answer to a product question.
  delete_product_question: Delete a product question.
  update_product_question: Update a product question.
  delete_product_question_answer: Delete a answer to a product question.
  update_product_question_answer: Update answer to a product question.
  show_returns: Get a list of your product returns.
  initiate_return: Initiate a product return.
  show_return: Show product return status.
  show_return_deliverers: Get a list of product return deliverers.
  show_prime_plans: Show information about prime plans available. Delivery fee is waived for prime members.
  show_prime_subscriptions: Show your prime subscription history.
  subscribe_prime: Subscribe to prime membership.
  download_prime_subscription_receipt: Download the receipt for a prime subscription.
  show_recommended_products: Show products recommended for you.
  show_browsing_history: Show products in your browsing history.
  clear_browsing_history: Clear your browsing history.
  add_product_to_browsing_history: Add a product to your browsing history.
  remove_product_from_browsing_history: Remove a product from your browsing history.
  update_browsing_history_tracking: Update browsing history tracking preference.
  show_last_product_purchase: Show your last purchase information of a product with the given ID or its size and color variations.
  show_product_rating_distribution: Show the rating distribution of a product.
  show_product_purchases: Show products you have purchased in the past.

  remove_song_from_playlist: Remove a song from a playlist.

  show_album_review: Show an album review.
  delete_album_review: Delete an album review.

  delete_playlist_review: Delete a playlist review.
  update_playlist_review: Update a playlist review.
  show_payment_cards: Get a list of users payment cards.
  add_payment_card: Add a new payment card.
  show_payment_card: Get details of a payment card.
  delete_payment_card: Delete payment card information.
  update_payment_card: Update payment card information.
  show_current_song: Show details of the current song on the queue.
  play_music: Play music based on various criteria. You can pass, at most, any one of queue_position, song_id, album_id or playlist_id. If one of song_id, album_id or playlist_id is passed, that song, album or playlist will be added to the queue and played. Otherwise, the queue will remain unchanged. If queue_position is passed, the song at that position in the queue will be played. If none is passed, the current song in the queue will be played.
  pause_music: Pause the currently playing song.
  previous_song: Go to the previous song in the song queue.
  next_song: Go to the next song in the song queue.
  move_song_in_queue: Move a song in the queue to a new position.
  seek_song: Seek the current song to the given number of seconds.
  loop_song: Set whether to loop the current song.
  shuffle_song_queue: Shuffle songs in the music player queue.
  show_song_queue: Get the music player song queue. Songs are played in the order of the queue in a cycle.
  add_to_queue: Add a song, album or playlist to the music player song queue.
  clear_song_queue: Clear the music player song queue.
  remove_song_from_queue: Remove a song at the given position from the music player song queue.
  show_volume: Get the volume level of the music player.
  set_volume: Set the volume level of the music player.
  show_recommendations: Get personalized song recommendations for the user.

  show_premium_subscriptions: Show your premium subscription history.
  subscribe_premium: Subscribe to premium membership.
  download_premium_subscription_receipt: Download the receipt for a premium subscription.

  update_draft: Update draft information.

  remove_attachment_from_draft: Delete an attachment from a draft.
  set_status: Set your availability status.
  search_labels: Search email thread labels by name.

  show_starred_threads: Show or search email threads you have starred. This will not show detailed information about emails within the thread.
  snooze_thread: Snooze an email thread until a given date and time in the future. It will reappear in unread state in your inbox and/or outbox at that time. It will also be removed from archived or spam categories if it was in either of those.
